newsitem.title: GERMANY: SOCCER-DORTMUND DEFEAT HELPS LEVERKUSEN TO SECOND PLACE.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-DORTMUND DEFEAT HELPS LEVERKUSEN TO SECOND PLACE.

text.p: Bayer Leverkusen leapfrogged to second place in the Bundesliga on Saturday when they won 1-0 at Freiburg as Borussia Dortmund suffered an embarrassing 3-1 home defeat to lowly Borussia Moechengladbach.
Striker Ulf Kirsten, with a 57th-minute penalty, and midfielder Paulo Sergio in the 61st minute, secured Leverkusen a victory which pushed reigning champions Dortmund into third place.
On Friday VfB Stuttgart stormed to the top of the league by beating Fortuna Duesseldorf 4-0 away.
Bayern Munich, who dropped to fourth place on Saturday, meet seventh-placed Karlsruhe on Sunday when a win would put them back on top.
Stuttgart and Leverkusen have 47 points, with Dortmund and Bayern both on 46.
In other games on Saturday Hamburg drew 2-2 at home with Bochum, St Pauli won 1-0 at Cologne and 1860 Munich beat Hansa Rostock 2-0.
